metadata.description: Automated mobile massage booking system with WhatsApp and YClients integration

tasks.title: WhatsApp Integration Setup
tasks.description: Set up WhatsApp Business API integration for message monitoring and automated responses
tasks.details: Configure WhatsApp Business API, implement webhook endpoints for receiving messages, and set up message parsing capabilities to extract booking information from client messages.
tasks.testStrategy: Test with sample WhatsApp messages containing booking requests to verify data extraction accuracy.

tasks.title: Message Data Extraction Engine
tasks.description: Implement intelligent parsing to extract client name, service type, date/time, and location from WhatsApp messages
tasks.details: Create regex patterns and NLP algorithms to parse various message formats. Handle different date/time formats, location descriptions, and service variations.
tasks.testStrategy: Test with various message formats and edge cases to ensure 99% accuracy in data extraction.

tasks.title: YClients API Integration
tasks.description: Integrate with YClients API for calendar management and appointment creation
tasks.details: Set up YClients API authentication, implement CRUD operations for appointments, clients, and services. Handle error cases and API rate limiting.
tasks.testStrategy: Create test appointments and verify they appear correctly in YClients calendar.

tasks.title: Automated Calendar Entry Creation
tasks.description: Automatically create calendar entries in YClients when new bookings are processed
tasks.details: Link extracted message data to YClients appointment creation. Handle scheduling conflicts, availability checking, and calendar updates.
tasks.testStrategy: Process booking messages and verify appointments are created with correct details in YClients.

tasks.title: Notification System
tasks.description: Implement WhatsApp notifications for therapists and drivers with booking details
tasks.details: Send automated WhatsApp notifications to assigned therapists and drivers with appointment details, location, and timing information.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify notifications are sent correctly and contain all necessary information.

tasks.title: Payment Management System
tasks.description: Implement payment tracking with automatic 5% VAT calculation
tasks.details: Track payment status for each booking, calculate VAT automatically, generate invoices, and handle payment confirmations.
tasks.testStrategy: Process various payment amounts and verify VAT calculations are accurate.

tasks.title: Subscription Package Management
tasks.description: Manage subscription packages with session tracking and automatic deductions
tasks.details: Track customer subscription packages, automatically deduct sessions when bookings are made, send alerts for low session counts.
tasks.testStrategy: Test subscription creation, session deduction, and alert notifications.

tasks.title: Database Schema and Models
tasks.description: Design and implement PostgreSQL database schema for all system entities
tasks.details: Create tables for bookings, clients, therapists, drivers, payments, subscriptions, and system logs. Implement proper relationships and indexes.
tasks.testStrategy: Run database migrations and test all CRUD operations.

tasks.title: User Authentication and Authorization
tasks.description: Implement JWT-based authentication for API endpoints
tasks.details: Set up user roles (admin, therapist, driver), implement login/logout functionality, and protect API endpoints with proper authorization.
tasks.testStrategy: Test login flows and verify endpoint access control.

tasks.title: Admin Dashboard
tasks.description: Create web dashboard for administrators to manage bookings and view analytics
tasks.details: Build React-based dashboard with booking management, payment tracking, subscription management, and basic analytics.
tasks.testStrategy: Test all dashboard features and verify data accuracy.

tasks.title: Error Handling and Logging
tasks.description: Implement comprehensive error handling and logging throughout the system
tasks.details: Add proper error handling for all operations, implement structured logging with Winston, and set up error monitoring.
tasks.testStrategy: Test error scenarios and verify proper logging and error responses.

tasks.title: Testing Suite
tasks.description: Create comprehensive test suite with unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
tasks.details: Implement Jest-based testing with high code coverage, API endpoint testing, and automated test workflows.
tasks.testStrategy: Run all tests and achieve minimum 80% code coverage.

tasks.title: Deployment and DevOps
tasks.description: Set up production deployment with Docker and CI/CD pipeline
tasks.details: Create Docker containers, set up deployment scripts, configure environment variables, and implement monitoring.
tasks.testStrategy: Deploy to staging environment and verify all features work correctly.

tasks.title: Documentation and User Guide
tasks.description: Create comprehensive API documentation and user guides
tasks.details: Document all API endpoints, create user manuals for administrators, and write deployment instructions.
tasks.testStrategy: Review documentation with stakeholders for completeness and clarity.

tasks.title: Performance Optimization
tasks.description: Optimize system performance and implement caching strategies
tasks.details: Implement Redis caching, optimize database queries, add response compression, and monitor performance metrics.
tasks.testStrategy: Load test the system and verify performance improvements.
